facts.text: John states that Aragorn is his favorite character because he is a great leader who puts others first and eventually becomes king.

evidence.quote: He's a great leader and puts others first - that's why he eventually becomes king.
My favorite character is Aragorn, he grows so much throughout the story.

facts.text: Tim comments on Aragorn's journey from a ranger to king of Gondor, noting his growth and redemption.

evidence.quote: Aragorn's story is so inspiring - from a ranger to king of Gondor. It's amazing how he grows and achieves redemption throughout his journey.

facts.text: John mentions that he has a painting in his room that serves as a reminder to stay true and be a leader in everything he does.

evidence.quote: I have a painting in my room to remind me to stay true and be a leader in everything I do.
